digital_teacher_desc: AI digital teacher. Current-session only: conversations are not persisted and reset on reload.
api_key_help_set: A key is configured (%mask%). Leave empty to keep it.
api_key_help_empty: Leave empty to keep the stored key (or to save without a key).
restriction_type_help: One of three (mutually exclusive): none, time range, count.
access_start_at_help: Start of the validity window in time-range mode.
access_end_at_help: End of the validity window in time-range mode.
expires_at_help: Leave empty for no time limit.
dt_tts_engine_help: Choose the speech engine: none disables it, cloud/edge/selfhosted use the configured TTS engine.
dt_avatar_type_help: Choose the avatar renderer: live2d / vrm / image / none.
dt_avatar_asset_help: Reference or URL of the uploaded avatar model/image (optional).
dt_tts_appid_help: AppID of the Volcengine speech application.
dt_tts_token_help_empty: Volcengine speech Access Token (never echoed back).
dt_chat_placeholder: Ask the digital teacher something to start…
dt_tts_none: No TTS engine configured — voice is disabled.
dt_tts_unavailable: Voice unavailable: engine not enabled or synthesis failed, kept text-only.
dt_error_no_permission: You do not have permission to access this digital teacher.
dt_error_key_decrypt: Failed to decrypt the API key.
